title: Testing for Monotone Equilibrium Strategies in Games of Incomplete Information
abstract: arXiv:2604.06643v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a unified framework for testing monotonicity of Bayesian Nash equilibrium strategies in unobserved types in games of incomplete information. We show that, under symmetric independent private types, monotonicity of differentiable equilibrium strategies is equivalent to monotonicity of a quasi-inverse strategy identified from observed actions. This allows the problem to be reformulated as testing a countable set of moment inequalities involving unconditional expectations. We propose a Cramer-von Mises-type statistic with bootstrap critical values. The method accommodates covariates and game heterogeneity. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate finite-sample performance, and an application to procurement auctions illustrates cartel detection.

translated_title: 不完全信息博弈中单调均衡策略的检验
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个统一框架，用于检验不完全信息博弈中贝叶斯纳什均衡策略关于不可观测类型的单调性。我们证明，在对称独立私人类型假设下，可微均衡策略的单调性等价于从观测行为中识别出的准逆策略的单调性。这使得该问题可以重新表述为检验涉及无条件期望的可数个矩不等式。我们提出了一种带有自助法临界值的Cramér-von Mises型统计量。该方法能够容纳协变量和博弈异质性。蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法的有限样本表现，而针对采购拍卖的应用则演示了卡特尔检测。
tldr: 本文提出了一个检验不完全信息博弈中均衡策略单调性的统一框架，将单调性检验转化为可数个矩不等式的检验并构造Cramér-von Mises型统计量，可应用于采购拍卖中的卡特尔检测。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified framework for testing monotonicity of equilibrium strategies in games of incomplete information by reformulating it as testing countable moment inequalities with a Cramér-von Mises-type statistic, with an application to cartel detection in procurement auctions.
